description: Two enforcement points, per DESIGN.md 4.1. SessionStart verifies every skill, agent definition and CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md under the project and ~/.claude, reporting failures into session context. PreToolUse(Skill) re-verifies the skill bundle at invocation time and blocks execution on a signature failure. Fail-open by default (the ecosystem is mostly unsigned); PROMPTSIGN_STRICT=1 makes both fail closed.
